name: AgentImageLabAdapter
description: Adapter-only dry-run bridge for Agent Image Lab. It generates a dispatch draft and blocks all real execution.
author: Agent Image Lab

invocationCommands.description: Only generate an Agent Image Lab dry-run dispatch draft. The request must include command=dry_run, task_envelope.mode=dry_run, max_plugin_calls=0, external_api_allowed=false, file_write_allowed=false, image binary disabled, Gatekeeper required, Review Console required, and DailyNote direct write disabled. The adapter never selects or calls a real image generation plugin.
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」AgentImageLabAdapter「末」,
command:「始」dry_run「末」,
task_envelope:「始」{ "task_id": "task-photo-studio-os-001", "mode": "dry_run", "dry_run_controls": { "max_plugin_calls": 0, "allow_external_api": false, "allow_file_write": false, "allow_image_binary": false }, "approval_context": { "gatekeeper_required": true, "review_console_required": true, "daily_note_direct_write_allowed": false }, "safety": { "contains_secret": false, "contains_private_path": false, "contains_customer_private_data": false, "contains_image_binary": false } }「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>

notes_cn: 这是 Adapter-only dry-run 插件清单，不代表真实生图能力已启用。
不调用任何 VCP 生图插件。
不包含 API key、token、cookie、密码、私密路径或客户隐私。
